label: Brig1 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a brig1-family locus whose encoded DNA glycosylase can excise alpha-glucosyl-hydroxymethylcytosine nucleobases from T-even bacteriophage DNA, generate abasic sites, and inhibit viral DNA replication.
observations: Brig1 branch under phage defense system; distinct from the individual brig1 gene, Brig1 DNA glycosylase proteins, DNA glycosylase activity outside a complete Brig1 phage-defense locus, alpha-glucosyl-hydroxymethylcytosine as a phage DNA modification, T4 or T-even phage host-range outcomes, the DefenseFinder Brig1__Brig1 and Brig1__ADP_ribosyl HMM profiles, source database rows naming one Brig1 profile hit, unresolved natural Brig1 host exemplars, unresolved Brig1-family subtype specificity, and other DNA glycosylase phage-defense systems.
